name: Europa
pages: Europa is found near Jupiter. Look for the structure with dark europa hydrate blocks.$(br2)Natural resources: iron, redstone, europan dust (cyan lunar dust).$(br)Mobs: Voided, Skeletons, SpaceFellows, Lunar Slimes

pages.text: Europan bricks can be used to craft a portal to Europa, and then lit using flint & steel.$(br)This does mean you need to visit Europa for the first time using the spaceship, or be in creative mode!$(br2)Note: portals can only be used to or from the overworld!
Check out some fun facts about Europa, courtesy of NASA!
